notes.title: A Gallery Exhibit Celebration!
notes.content:
If yer a collector (and what good pirate isn't!), ye'll likely have a grand collection of furniture gatherin' dust in yer booty. If yer one to want to show off yer imposing assemblage, be sure to visit yer local island to find the [b]Gallery[/b]! This expansive new [url=http://yppedia.puzzlepirates.com/House]house[/url] features large rooms with voluminous wall space, and a floorplan to showcase yer most complex arrangement of goods. Host a [b]Gallery Exhibit[/b]! A whisk to yer Gallery will appear on the notice board for a week, and allow pirates to browse yer fine display.

[img]http://content.puzzlepirates.com/images/spyglass/2015aug/housing_sale.png[/img]

To celebrate the release of the Gallery, we're havin' a [b]sale on select sizes of pirate housing[/b]! This applies to both the cost in pieces of eight as well as the doubloon fee on doubloon oceans.

[b]Save 10%[/b]
[list][*]Row Houses[/*][*]Townhouses[/*][*]Manors[/*][*]Villas[/*][/list]
[b]Save 20%[/b]
[list][*]Mansions[/*][*]Estates[/*][*]Pirate Halls (both crew and flag)[/*][/list]
If yer plannin' to upgrade yer residence, or just lookin' to add a summer getaway, act fast! [b]All housing prices will return to normal at 3 PM, August 10, 2015.[/b]

notes.title: Open Markets!
notes.content:
The ocean calls to all pirates. With a ship under yer pegleg, kegs full o' rum, and the potential for a hold full of booty, ye look to the horizon for the next grand adventure. [b]We're celebratin' World Oceans Day with an Open Markets Event![/b] Set sail for adventure, pillagin', and a bit o' monkey business!

[img]http://content.puzzlepirates.com/images/spyglass/2015jun/open_markets.png[/img]

[list]
[*]Markets are paying up to 25% more for [url=http://yppedia.puzzlepirates.com/Fruit]fruit[/url].*
[*][url=http://yppedia.puzzlepirates.com/Gems]Gem[/url] thieves are less active, so large quantities of gems are more likely to make it through a voyage.
[*][url=http://yppedia.puzzlepirates.com/Merchant_brigands]Merchant brigands[/url] are operating at an increased rate and shipping their goods to distant destinations. Their attraction to [url=http://yppedia.puzzlepirates.com/Trading_post[/url]trading posts[/url] is increased.
[*]Compelled by an abundance of fruit, encounters with the mischievous Monkey Boat are more common.
[*]Brigand and barbarian ships are more attracted to islands with a [url=http://yppedia.puzzlepirates.com/Black_market]Black Market[/url] and are carrying more booty.
[/list]

[b]The Open Markets event will be active until June 10th at 3:00 PM PST. The ocean calls, mateys![/b]

[i]*Market owners won't be offering this rate until after the 4AM reboot on June 5. They muttered somethin' about labor limits.[/i]

notes.title: Expedition Rally!
notes.content:
It seems while ye pirates were busy making a love connection with Pinkfoot, the Empire’s outposts were stocked, and Vikings were more daring with their raids! Load a crew on yer ship, and grab something pointy to prepare for an [b]expedition rally[/b]! During this event [url=http://yppedia.puzzlepirates.com/Expedition>expeditions[/url] will be easier to find, and they will have greater treasures to win. [list][*]Quite a bit o’ treasure has built up on the [url=http://yppedia.puzzlepirates.com/Imperial_outpost>Imperial Outposts[/url] and Viking raider ships[/url], resulting in [b]more for ye pirates to plunder[/b].[/*][*]Sinking Imperial Outposts [b]increased rum and shot[/b] on their ships, which ye pirates are happy to take off their hands.[/*][*]The chance of finding expeditions while pillaging is increased.[/*][*]For ye pirates who prefer exploration over battle, [b]buried treasure expeditions[/b] are yielding more pieces of eight.[/*][/list] Be sure to visit the Explorers’ Hall[/url] for the latest rumors and locations for Empire strongholds and Viking activity. Charts for Viking Raids and Imperial Outposts will appear more frequently. Expedition maps may also be found inside some Black Boxes[/url].
Viking and Imperial trinkets are awarded to victorious pirates who own a subscription on Cerulean or those who possess a [url=http://yppedia.puzzlepirates.com/Badge#Pirate_badge>rank badge[/url] on doubloon oceans. Trinkets can be exchanged for special items at the

notes.title: Late Fall Haul!
notes.content:
Don’t let that stash of fruit rot in the hold of your ship! Old Salts around the ocean have been whispering about markets paying more for fruit and gem thieves being lazy varmints. They also report a parrot squakin’ about merchant and brigand ships sailin' with a mighty fine bit o' booty aboard.
[img]http://content.puzzlepirates.com/images/spyglass/2013nov/open_markets_fall.png[/img]
Grab yer hearties and set out to sea to make yer own late fall haul! [list][*]Markets are paying up to 25% more for fruit.[/*][*]Gem thieves are less active, so large quantities of gems are more likely to make it through a voyage.[/*][*]Merchant brigands are operating at an increased rate and shipping their goods to distant destinations. Their attraction to trading posts is increased.[/*][*]Compelled by an abundance of fruit, encounters with the mischievous Monkey Boat are more common.[/*][*]Brigand and barbarian ships are more attracted to islands with a Black Market and are carrying more booty.[/*][/list]
[img]http://content.puzzlepirates.com/images/spyglass/2013nov/fall_sales_a.png[/img]
In addition to open markets, Crimson Jim is having an inventory reduction sale! He is including special items [b]free[/b] when ye purchase doubloons or subscription time. Ye may find furniture, amulets, pets, chroma and more! Be sure the item icon shows up next to your chosen package on the subscription or doubloon billing page when you go to make your purchase. Some of these items will change daily, so check in frequently so you don’t miss out! [b]The Late Fall Haul event will be active until November 26th at 3:00 PM PST. Good fortunes, mateys![/b]
